info.title: mdlive
info.description: Live preview of Markdown rendered with your own Markdig pipeline and styles, driven from an editor such as Neovim.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Create .mdlive in the current directory with default style.css and template.html.
Fails if .mdlive already exists and isn't empty.
--force, -f  Overwrite the default files, other files in .mdlive are kept.

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Start the preview server on a random port on 127.0.0.1 and print
{"port":<port>,"token":"<access token>"} to stdout; open http://127.0.0.1:<port>/#<token>.
Reads editor messages from stdin, exits when stdin is closed.
--trust <dir>  Run .mdlive/config.csx from <dir> and its subdirectories without
`mdlive trust`. Only for directories nobody else writes to. Repeatable.
--AllowedHosts <hosts>  Host headers to accept, ; separated (default: loopback only).
--Logging:<key> <value>  Logging configuration, e.g. --Logging:LogLevel:Default Debug.
--embedded  For a preview framed inside an editor (VS Code webview): session cookie
SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned and CSP frame-ancestors.
--frame-ancestors <sources>  Who may frame it with --embedded
(default: 'self' vscode-webview: vscode-file:).
Other options are rejected.

commands.name: trust
commands.description:
Review and trust .mdlive/config.csx with everything it loads. Only a trusted
config script is run, any change to it has to be trusted again.
--show       Only list the files, their hashes and the trust status.
--json       Print the listing as JSON.
--hash <h>   Trust only if the config still has this hash (non-interactive use).
--revoke     Forget the trust for this config.

commands.name: version
commands.description:
Show the version of mdlive and of the bundled ScuroGuardiano.MdLive.ConfigBase,
to use in #r "nuget: ScuroGuardiano.MdLive.ConfigBase, <version>".
